report.summary: Payment-service p95 latency increased from 0.24s to 0.94s over a 5‑minute window, indicating degraded performance.

likely_causes.title: High request volume causing increased latency
likely_causes.rationale: Latency spike correlates with increased traffic load.

likely_causes.title: Resource contention within payment-service pods
likely_causes.rationale: High latency may be due to CPU/memory contention within the service pods.

likely_causes.title: External dependency slowdown
likely_causes.rationale: Payment-service may be waiting on external services such as databases or payment gateways.

next_steps: Check request volume metrics for payment-service
Inspect pod CPU/memory usage and limits
Verify health and latency of external dependencies

detail: High request volume causing increased latency
